rationale: The stock is trading at 99.8% of its intraday range after a 7.62% gap-up and a massive intraday move from $51.27 to $62.66, with price essentially at the session high and no news catalyst visible to explain the move. Entering long at the extreme top of a parabolic move with no pullback carries extreme reversal risk, while shorting into a stock with this kind of momentum and 7.7x relative volume is equally dangerous. With no clear structural edge in either direction and price at a precarious extreme, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
